description: This file contains unit tests for polymorphic grain interfaces in an Orleans-based distributed system. It demonstrates how grains can implement multiple interfaces with inheritance hierarchies, and how grain references can be cast between compatible interfaces. The tests cover polymorphic method calls, interface upcasting, factory-created references, multiple interface exposures, ambiguous method resolution, and complex inheritance scenarios.

classes.name: PolymorphicInterfaceTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests verifying polymorphic interface behaviors in Orleans grains, including method dispatch, casting, and inheritance hierarchies.

methods.name: Polymorphic_SimpleTest
methods.description: Tests that a grain implementing interface IA can respond to its methods correctly.

methods.name: Polymorphic_UpCastTest
methods.description: Verifies upcasting grain references through interface inheritance chains and that methods remain accessible after casting.

methods.name: Polymorphic_FactoryMethods
methods.description: Tests factory methods returning polymorphic grain references as different interface types.

methods.name: Polymorphic_ServiceType
methods.description: Tests a grain implementing multiple interfaces to expose multiple functionality sets.

methods.name: Polymorphic_InheritedMethodAmbiguity
methods.description: Checks resolution of intersecting method signatures when multiple interfaces define methods with the same name.

methods.name: Polymorphic__DerivedServiceType
methods.description: Complex test scenario involving a derived grain type implementing multiple interfaces and verifying access to their methods.
